verdict.rationale: Omnirush is a desktop coding-agent app, so debugging a live web application from the assistant is a fair axis for it. The evidence documents git workflows, model selection and permissions, but nothing on attaching to, inspecting or debugging a running web app. The ability to add generic MCP servers is a building block a user could assemble, not the product's own live-debugging capability, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can debug a live running web application directly from my coding assistant
